title: Move the party, add creatures and start encounters from the map
summary: The map's quick actions move the party between maps and set up encounters right where you clicked.
items: Move party to shows what will happen before it moves the party's place, the players' scene and the party's tokens in one step.
When the party is split, choose which group moves.
Add creatures here searches the SRD, adds the creatures to an encounter and places them hidden from players.
Add characters here places any characters you tick, in the party's formation, with Undo.
Start encounter here uses this map, and New encounter creates one on the spot.
